notes:
Lead: Aisha Patel. Target: private VPC + BYOK for production inference (customer-facing support & transaction reranking). Eng/Infra evaluation underway. High-level summary:
- Use-case constraints: PII + transaction metadata cannot leave customer-controlled keys/regions. Need proof of at-rest encryption with customer-managed keys, and ability to rotate keys without service interruption.
- Encryption posture asked by SecOps: mTLS for all service-to-service traffic (client <> inference gateway <> GPU pods), mutual certs integrated with internal PKI or Redwood-managed certs with rotation hooks. Expect to require cert pinning for canary nodes.
- At-rest: All model artifacts, KV cache snapshots, and logs must be encrypted with KMS/HSM (BYOK preferred). Ask: support for AWS KMS + CloudHSM, Azure Key Vault, and on-prem HSM via PKCS#11.
- Key rotation: Must support automated rotation cadence (30/90/180d), with zero-downtime rewrap and key versioning; SE flagged whether Redwood supports rewrap + old-key fallback for tokenized cache.
- Secrets management: Prefer HashiCorp Vault integration (transit/kv engines). Need examples: how secrets are mounted into inference nodes, lifecycle of short-lived creds, support for Vault AppRole and rotation of Vault tokens.
- In-transit encryption: End-to-end TLS, with optional mTLS. Requirement: TLS1.3, strict cipher suites, and mutual auth for internal RPC. Preference for mTLS using SPIRE or SPIFFE identity; if not, Redwood must provide cert rotation API and audit events.
- Audit logging & monitoring: All KMS calls, key changes, certificate events, and secret access must be exported to customer SIEM. Prefer CloudTrail-equivalent for on-prem: syslog/structured JSON push to customer SIEM (Splunk/Datadog). Need retention controls (7y/3y buckets).
- Data residency: Data-at-rest and backups must stay in customer-specified regions; snapshot replication across regions blocked by default. Clarify if Redwood backups or metrics have any PII.
- Compliance artifacts requested: SOC2 Type II, ISO27001 attestation, encryption architecture diagram, and KMS key policy template. Legal to review BYOK/lang: need contractual language for key escrow: customer insists on no escrow.
